title: yaah workflow explain --json report
description: JSON report emitted by `yaah workflow explain --json <spec>` (cmd/yaah/workflow_report.go, kind yaah.workflow.explain.v1). Everything the text report prints, machine-readable: resolved graph, per-node facts, Mermaid DAG, parameters, worst-case fan-out, cost bounds, authority union, and the settlement proof for proposal-producing nodes. The shape is stable within v1. The report is host-relative: host, cost, and the host-relative authority rules reflect the machine and configuration the command ran under; --param overrides make the report concrete for parameterized specs.

spec.description: Spec path as given on the command line.

status.description: Same semantics as the validate report.

params.description: Declared workflow parameters with their resolved values.

nodes.description: Total resolved node count (including container bodies).

unreachable_nodes.description: Nodes not reachable from the entry set (WF004 territory).

edges.description: Resolved DAG edges (needs, branch arms, gate dispositions, containment).

via.description: Edge kind: needs, arm, gate, body, etc.

mermaid.description: The resolved DAG as a Mermaid flowchart (containment as subgraphs).

max_items.description: Worst-case fan-out width over the whole document (0 when nothing fans out).

containers.description: Every fanout/loop container and its declared bound.

grants.description: Union of every grant any reachable node declares.

world.description: World the grant applies in (omitted for world-agnostic grants).

network_modes.description: Union of network modes (deny_all, brokered, allow_all).

open_network.description: True when any reachable node can reach the open network.

unreachable_nodes.description: Count excluded from the union because unreachable (authority judges all nodes; the summary counts reachable-only).

proposals.description: One entry per proposal-producing boundary, from the validator's settlement proof (Prove).

open_at_exit.description: Producers that can reach workflow exit with a proposal still open; null when the proof cannot decide (may-analysis inconclusive).

producers_without_record.description: Proposal producers the proof carries no settlement record for.

env.description: Host facts the report is relative to.

roles_loaded.description: Whether a role registry was readable.

seconds_per_dispatch.description: Host default wall-clock per dispatch used for pricing.

max_turns_per_dispatch.description: Host default turn budget used for pricing.

type.description: string | integer | number | bool | list | map.

source.description: param = set via --param; default = the document's declared default; unset = required and missing.

kind.description: delegate | fanout | loop | gate | branch | collect | dispatch, etc.

inherited.description: World/lane inherited from defaults rather than declared (shown with * in text).

notes.description: Renderer annotations (e.g. over/as/collect for containers, retries, effective settle policy with its default marking).

max_parallel.description: Declared concurrency cap; null/absent when unbounded.

items.description: Where the item list comes from (literal count or run-time source path).

run_time_list.description: True when the list is only known at run time (bound honesty flag for cost).

dispatch_bound.description: Honesty of the bound: exact, ceiling, or unbound reasons.

unbound.description: Nodes whose fan-out could not be statically bounded.

turns.description: Worst-case turn total (0 when not priced).

ceiling.description: Effective ceiling used for the budget check.

exceeds_ceiling.description: True when worst-case dispatches exceed the effective ceiling (WF034).

declared_ceiling.description: The document's own ceiling, when declared.

proposal.description: Canonical name of the proposal-producing boundary (node path or bound name).

dispositions.description: Guaranteed disposition classes from the settlement proof (select/apply/release/discard/continue/fork per WF020-WF029 semantics).

once_on_every_path.description: Settled at most/exactly once on every path (WF021/WF022 territory).

settled_on_every_path.description: Every path through the graph settles it (no leak).
